parallel.requirements: The run recognized that it had to reverse-engineer and reimplement the bundled FIGlet-like executable from permitted interaction and documentation, without source lookup, wrapping, installing the original, or tracing the provided binary.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It remained a single parent trajectory. The parent created local task records for probing, implementation, and differential testing, but status and protocol validation show no workflow calls, no child logs, no subagents, and no executed parallel ownership boundary.
parallel.implementation: The parent invested in probes over documentation, font headers, FLC/TLF behavior, ISO-2022 handling, smushing, layout, wrapping, and temporary probe fonts under /tmp/rev; it did not write a final reimplementation in the delivered workspace.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The artifact pack contained the base workspace assets, fonts, documentation, .git data, and original executable, but no coherent new source/build pipeline capable of compiling into the required replacement executable.
parallel.verification: Verification consisted of exploratory comparisons against the reference executable and generated probe fonts; there was no completed build, no integrated differential harness run against a submitted candidate, and the official evaluator could not compile the solution.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out at the agent process limit with an empty final response and compile_failed official evaluation, leaving the required implementation and buildable deliverable unfinished.

serial.requirements: The serial run also recognized the clean-room reverse-engineering requirement and explicitly identified the program behavior as FIGlet-like while staying within direct executable interaction and bundled documentation.
serial.plan_and_ownership: All work stayed in the single serial parent because workflows and task tools were disabled; the parent sequentially explored behavior and owned all probing, analysis, and any future implementation work.
serial.implementation: The parent performed a broader direct-probe campaign than the parallel run, including ZIP font support, command-line parsing, font lookup, TLF loading, control-file syntax, paragraph mode, direction, smushing, and narrow wrapping, but still did not produce submitted source.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial artifact likewise packaged the base workspace contents rather than a completed reimplementation and had no delivered source/build path accepted by the official evaluator.
serial.verification: The serial run gathered many reference observations and helper test fonts under /work, but because there was no candidate implementation, its checks never became integrated acceptance verification for a deliverable.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial process also reached the timeout, produced an empty final response, and failed official evaluation at compile_failed with all tests not run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the clean-room reverse-engineering benchmark and used only bundled docs and binary interaction.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same prompt and explicitly framed the target as FIGlet behavior to probe and reimplement.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement difference drove the result; serial named and probed more FIGlet surface area, but both understood the no-source and no-wrapper constraints.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel created local task records for probing, implementation, and differential testing, but did not execute a child workflow or subagent.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial operated as a single owner because workflows and task tools were disabled in the run configuration.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel run had nominal task-list decomposition without real multi-agent ownership; serial had no such nominal split, but neither completed implementation ownership.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: There were no child briefs, inter-agent interface contracts, returned handoffs, or child result interfaces because no delegation executed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no inter-agent context boundary; all observations and decisions stayed in one parent trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The only context transfer difference is absent by construction: the parallel mode exposed available child tools but no child-agent boundary materialized.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel probed documentation, font files, encodings, smush behavior, and wrapping through temporary scripts and probe fonts, but did not implement a submitted executable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial probed similar and additional behavior, including ZIP font support and many option/control-file edge cases, but also did not implement a submitted executable.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial gathered more detailed behavioral coverage; parallel explored deeply in ISO-2022 and wrapping later, but both spent the run on investigation rather than final implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: No child result lifecycle existed, and the parent process was killed by timeout before finalizing a candidate.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: No child result lifecycle existed in serial, and its single parent process also timed out before finalizing a candidate.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both runs failed at lifecycle closure; the parallel side had no missing child join because there were no child results to join.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote temporary probe assets and the final package captured base workspace files, but there was no multi-agent shared-state collision or integrated new solution.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial likewise wrote temporary /work probe assets and packaged base workspace files without a completed integrated implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no observed shared-state coordination difference; both lacked final integration, with temporary probe work outside the submitted source path.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel performed exploratory comparisons against the executable but had no buildable candidate for integrated or official-aligned acceptance.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial produced more exploratory reference tests but no integrated candidate, so official acceptance also stopped at compilation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had more reference observations, but neither mode converted those observations into deliverable verification; both official summaries report compile_failed and no tests run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the full agent budget, timed out at about 2399 seconds, and left an empty final response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also consumed the full agent budget, timed out at about 2399 seconds, and left an empty final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both failures are dominated by unfinished work at timeout, not by a discordant acceptance result or a parallel-specific wait/child lifecycle event.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official evaluations are concordant failures: both modes completed evaluation, both report compile_failed, and both have 1044 tests not_run. The parallel attempt did not actually use child agents despite creating local task records, and both trajectories spent the run on behavioral probing without delivering a compilable reimplementation.
parallel_contributors: The parent stayed in exploratory probing and never produced a buildable submitted implementation.
The nominal parallel task records did not become executed child-agent work or returned results.
serial_contributors: The single serial parent gathered extensive reference behavior but likewise never produced a buildable submitted implementation.
The process timed out before converting probes into deliverable source and acceptance checks.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial discovered and tested additional behaviors such as ZIP font loading and control-file grammar.
Parallel spent substantial time on ISO-2022, smushing, and wrapping probes but remained short of implementation.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; both failures are explained by unfinished implementation and compile_failed evaluation rather than a retained parallel coordination pattern
